subtitulo: General data, lore for the AI, own model, current session, export and deletion.

general.descripcion: Name, description and game modules of the campaign.
general.idAyuda: Part of URLs and IRIs; it cannot be changed.
general.modulosAyuda: Removing a module does not delete data already created with its types, but they will lose their own form.
general.sinModulos: No modules installed besides the core.

lore.descripcion: Context the assistant and agents always receive before proposing changes.
lore.resumenAyuda: Premise, recent history and current situation.
lore.tonoPlaceholder: e.g. personal horror, political intrigue, noir
lore.reglasCasaAyuda: Your own rules or tweaks to the game system.
lore.evitarAyuda: Topics or elements that must not appear.
lore.notasAyuda: Any other useful information for the AI.

asistente.descripcion: Only for this campaign. Empty = use the global settings.

sesion.descripcion: Temporal changes (where someone is, which faction they belong to, their status…) are dated in this session.
sesion.sinSesiones: The campaign has no sessions yet.

exportar.descripcion: Download a ZIP with all data (RDF), images and settings. It can be imported into another installation from the campaign list.

peligro.descripcion: Deleting the campaign permanently removes its data, proposals, history and images.
peligro.dialogoAviso: This cannot be undone. Export the campaign first if you want to keep a copy.
